Third-party files used by PeergosEasyEdit, unchanged from their publishers. Their sources and SHA-256 sums are
listed in tools/vendor.json of the source code (python tools/fetch_vendor.py checks them).

toastui/  Toast UI Editor 3.2.2 - MIT License (toastui/LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2020 NHN Cloud Corp.
          The all-in-one build includes ProseMirror (MIT) and DOMPurify 2.3.3 (Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0).
katex/    KaTeX 0.16.11 - MIT License (katex/LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Khan Academy and other contributors.
          Only the WOFF2 fonts are included.
